name: purchase-flow
description: Canonical 그림책 제작소 ENTRY-LINE buyer journey (기념일/첫 순간들): home → category → configure → cart → TossPayments (test) → PAID confirmation → mypage finishing. Graded as features land; each step names the real E2E/integration check that grades it. Durable Postgres persistence (orders/finishing/custom) is wired (Prisma, verified across a simulated restart) AND durable object storage of upload BYTES is live (Supabase Storage, verified by an upload→read-back→cleanup round-trip). Unbuilt steps report as PENDING, never success. Holdout variants live in eval/holdout/ and are never used to tune (G4).

steps.desc: Home renders the brand hero + 3-category featured region
Open the 기념일 category and see the seeded template cards
Configure a book: 이름·성별 + the template variable, validated
Skip the optional child photo (never blocks payment)
Choose a cover (소프트 43,000 / 하드 49,000원); line price reflects it
Cart shows the personalized line + grand total in won
Checkout via TossPayments (test/sandbox) → order marked PAID (idempotent)
Order confirmation shows items, total, status PAID (no PII)
Mypage finishing: dedication saved + prefilled, photo upload if skipped
Paid order + per-item finishing (dedication, photo descriptor) persist to Postgres across a restart
steps.verify: integration: Prisma persistence (order create→get→markPaid survives a fresh client; finishing round-trip)

steps.desc: Uploaded photo BYTES stored durably in object storage (Supabase Storage), not just the descriptor
steps.verify: integration: Supabase Storage putObject round-trip (persistence-integration.test.ts) — upload → read-back → cleanup
